verses.text: Rejoice with me; I have found my lost sheep.
verses.title: Jesus Looks for the Lost

verses.text: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise. Many are the plans in a person’s heart, but it is the Lord ’s purpose that prevails.
Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.
